CHESSNOMICON

Liber Scaccorum Mortuorum — the book where words become moves

How to read. (v2: 50+ cases — openings, tactics, mating nets, endings and two immortal games.) Select any passage with your cursor or finger — a line, a chapter, any length, no word limit. The Eye on the right wakes and replays every chess case you touched, in Terminator vision, scoring each move. Or open the CMD under the board and type help, or press Surprise me.

Scriptorium — the prompt shell

Write a prompt, highlight it, watch it run. Mix plain words and chess: name a case (fork, sicilian, opera), a chapter (openings, tactics), moves, a FEN, a vision colour, a speed. Edit the lines freely; each highlight is a fresh command.

the fork and the smothered mate in green vision

all the openings in cyan at 4x
